description: Brutus Shield starter offline Android malware rule database. Exact hashes are sourced from public MalwareBazaar records; behavior rules are generic indicators and are not family verdicts.

behaviorRules.name: Banking-trojan style overlay control
behaviorRules.reason: Accessibility control and screen overlays appear together with communication or identity access often abused by credential-stealing malware.

behaviorRules.name: Dynamic-code dropper behavior
behaviorRules.reason: The package can install apps and load code dynamically, with additional execution, network, or persistence indicators.

behaviorRules.name: Surveillance/spyware permission bundle
behaviorRules.reason: Persistent microphone access is combined with several high-value surveillance permissions.

behaviorRules.name: Installed-app signature mismatch
behaviorRules.reason: An APK claims an installed package name but is signed by a different certificate, so it cannot be a legitimate update from the same publisher.

behaviorRules.name: Ransomware-style device control
behaviorRules.reason: Device administration and cryptography are combined with persistence or destructive file-control indicators.

behaviorRules.name: SMS fraud behavior bundle
behaviorRules.reason: SMS sending is combined with interception, device identity, persistence, or dynamically loaded code.
